-- ============================================================
-- test-15-scope_pos.fh  –  scope/spawn/join/await PASS-Tests
--   (SCP-01..03, SCP-06..08)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Scope.Pos

-- SCP-08: async function mit await
async function fetch_value(id: Integer) returns Integer
requires id > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    return id * 2
end fetch_value

async function fetch_sum(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Integer
requires a > 0, b > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    let va: Integer = await fetch_value(a)
    let vb: Integer = await fetch_value(b)
    return va + vb
end fetch_sum

-- SCP-01: scope … spawn … join … result … end scope
async procedure run_tasks()
is
    scope worker do
        spawn
            let value_handle: JoinHandle<Integer> = worker.spawn<Integer>(fetch_value(1))
        join
            let n: Integer = await worker.join<Integer>(value_handle)
            call Std.IO.logf("spawned: ${}", n)
            call Std.IO.logf("joined")
        result
            call Std.IO.logf("done")
    end scope
end run_tasks

-- SCP-03: leerer spawn-Block
async procedure empty_spawn()
is
    scope empty_w do
        spawn
        join
            call Std.IO.logf("after empty spawn")
        result
            call Std.IO.logf("result")
    end scope
end empty_spawn

-- SCP-02: scope() als Ausdruck mit spawn/join API
async function scope_expr(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n > 0
ensures result >= 0
is
    let active: Scope = scope()
    let handle: JoinHandle<Integer> = active.spawn<Integer>(fetch_value(n))
    let joined_value: Integer = await active.join<Integer>(handle)
    return joined_value
end scope_expr

-- SCP-06: .spawn / .join als typisierte Scope-Methoden
async procedure member_access(n: Integer)
requires n > 0
is
    let active: Scope = scope()
    let handle: JoinHandle<Integer> = active.spawn<Integer>(fetch_value(n))
    let j: Integer = await active.join<Integer>(handle)
    call Std.IO.logf("j=${}", j)
end member_access

-- SCP-01 PASS: Scope mit Datenaustausch
async function parallel(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Integer
requires a > 0, b > 0
ensures result > 0
is
    let total: Integer = 0
    scope fetch do
        spawn
            let va_handle: JoinHandle<Integer> = fetch.spawn<Integer>(fetch_value(a))
            let vb_handle: JoinHandle<Integer> = fetch.spawn<Integer>(fetch_value(b))
        join
            let va: Integer = await fetch.join<Integer>(va_handle)
            let vb: Integer = await fetch.join<Integer>(vb_handle)
            total := va + vb
            check total >= 0
        result
            call Std.IO.logf("total = ${}", total)
    end scope
    return total
end parallel

end Test.Scope.Pos
